offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace connecting homeowners with local home service professionals for repairs, remodeling and maintenance. Earns fees from service professionals for leads and jobs, and offers homeowners tools to search, compare reviews and book services.

primary_services.value: online home services marketplace; lead generation for service professionals; service booking and quote requests; advertising for service professionals

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners seeking repair, remodeling and maintenance services; B2B: home service professionals and contractors who pay for leads and advertising

end_markets.value: home services; home improvement; remodeling; home maintenance and repair

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees from service professionals per lead or per booked job; advertising: service professionals pay for advertising and premium placement; subscription: membership and subscription fees from some service professionals
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: digital marketplace taking in service professional listings and homeowner requests, connecting both sides

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada

specialization.value: related lines: lead generation, booked-services marketplace and advertising for home services

distribution_channels.value: online: website and mobile apps for homeowners and professionals; direct sales: sales team enrolling service professionals in advertising and lead programs

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general consumer protection, advertising and data privacy rules, professional licensing handled by providers
